title: Explicit attributed operator trust for fresh repository-only pickup
summary: Add one exact --trust-source CLI assertion for repository-only pickup, disable option abbreviation on only the pickup subparser for all of its options, parse CLI/receipt data through one fail-closed factory into a frozen typed value, compare it byte-for-byte with the shelf authorized source SHA and incumbent Design/receipt lineage identities, and explicitly serialize it into a strict v2 receipt with a false cryptographic-authenticity claim. Preserve canonical --workspace, root/unrelated parser behavior, the existing v1 private-secret path, and all BUILD-C/checkpoint/merge/atomic-publication owners. The human scope decision classifies incumbent unique-prefix acceptance as accidental, undocumented, and unsupported; no compatibility shim is authorized. Retain asymmetric contract ids as historical backlog metadata only, with no runtime realization.

current_state.summary: At exact HEAD a73f125e762670323d0e4a8fbbef3a1edf3ea958, tp.py exposes pickup with a shelf path and canonical --workspace only, and its pickup subparser inherits argparse option abbreviation because it does not set allow_abbrev. Although argparse currently accepts unique shortened spellings, the human scope decision classifies that behavior as accidental, undocumented, and outside the supported governed-caller contract. pickup.py chooses the existing private-secret verifier when .taskplane authority exists and otherwise accepts a closed structural shelf only after a prior repository receipt; it validates exact source/Design/receipt/checkpoint/merge lineage, invokes the incumbent build_c.run_pickup seam, and atomically publishes strict taskplane.pickup-receipt/v1. The second-checkout, lineage-tamper, severed-edge, publication, and interruption tests already exist. Decisions 0008 and 0009 require an explicit attributed operator assertion with no cryptographic-origin claim and preserve the inherited actor-string/private-symmetric limitation. Product corrected executable authority to exactly three acceptance criteria and seven active contracts, removing only two stale asymmetric requirement edges. The current Design baseline at the same HEAD is c6e3f9ed00e00c75fe07d3a4734633ea19d36d81b7a7ef4ce39d289025e26199 (55/177).

decision: Select explicit attributed operator trust because decision 0008 requires the smallest honest repository-only continuation: the pickup subparser alone sets allow_abbrev=False, all pickup options require canonical spellings, and the caller supplies the exact --trust-source token plus one full source SHA. The attributed human scope decision classifies incumbent unique-prefix parsing as accidental, undocumented, and unsupported for internal governed callers; canonical --workspace remains supported and no compatibility shim is introduced. One fail-closed factory creates a frozen typed pickup-internal value, pickup proves structural/lineage agreement, and one explicit serializer records it in the next atomic receipt while denying a cryptographic-origin claim. A strict additive v2 receipt preserves existing v1 bytes and allows the completed first v1 criterion to precede the second-checkout v2 criterion. Revised Design approval also provides a one-delivery human tooling disposition: no pydantic/ruff/black/mypy/pyright addition in this standard-library/protected-surface scope, with incumbent compile/import/introspection/pytest and manual escape-hatch checks instead; this is not precedent. No compatibility alias, root-wide CLI, handwritten argv scan, private argparse override, asymmetric, signing, key, protected-surface, alternate execution, or private-state work is introduced.

failure_modes.recovery: The human operator selects the intended shelf/source or stops for scope review; pickup edits neither and never reaches BUILD-C.

failure_modes.mode: A v2 operator object is malformed, asserts true, carries another value, or a v1 receipt follows v2.
